test_status_rules.status_and_triage: A test has a status (test_statuses) and, when it is not PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE, a separate triage class (finding_classes). FAIL is always FATAL_DEFECT; CONDITIONAL is ACCEPTED_RISK or PENDING_EVIDENCE.
test_status_rules.not_applicable: NOT_APPLICABLE needs a stated reason, never counts as PASS, and is forbidden where not_applicable_allowed is false (epistemic, exit).

coherence_tests.name: Política / Political-purpose
coherence_tests.question: Does the immediate result serve the superior purpose?

coherence_tests.name: Causal / Causal
coherence_tests.question: Is there an explicit explanation of how the action produces the effect?

coherence_tests.name: Interactiva / Interactive
coherence_tests.question: Does the design survive a competent reaction or adaptation?

coherence_tests.name: De conversión / Conversion
coherence_tests.question: Do the available resources convert into the required control or capacity?

coherence_tests.name: De legitimidad / Legitimacy
coherence_tests.question: Does the method preserve the cooperation and authority needed to hold the result?

coherence_tests.name: Epistémica / Epistemic
coherence_tests.question: Are evidence, hypotheses, assumptions, attributed intentions and unknowns separated, and does the separation survive the summary?

coherence_tests.name: De salida / Exit
coherence_tests.question: Are there criteria to stop, adapt, transfer, terminate and conserve?

pathologies.name: Inversión de niveles / Level inversion
pathologies.definition: A tactical or local metric replaces the superior result.
pathologies.mechanism: Executors are rewarded for local results and adapt the purpose to their metrics.
pathologies.correction: Evaluate each success by its contribution to the end state.

pathologies.name: Objetivo nominal / Nominal objective
pathologies.definition: An end is declared without an observable success condition.
pathologies.mechanism: An abstract word lets each actor understand something different.
pathologies.correction: Write an observable and sufficient condition.

pathologies.name: Centro de gravedad imaginario / Imaginary Centre of Gravity
pathologies.definition: The visible target is mistaken for the systemic dependency.
pathologies.mechanism: Importance is inferred from visibility, rank or familiarity.
pathologies.correction: State a counterfactual dependency and look for substitutes.

pathologies.name: Confusión de conceptos / Concept confusion
pathologies.definition: Centre of gravity, Schwerpunkt, decisive point and vulnerability are used as synonyms.
pathologies.mechanism: One word names the source of power, the own focus and the accessible target.
pathologies.correction: Declare the convention and give each term its own question.

pathologies.name: Dispersión / Dispersion
pathologies.definition: Every priority is funded and none receives decisive concentration.
pathologies.mechanism: Each demand obtains priority without reducing another.
pathologies.correction: Fix the main effort, the minimums and the renunciations.

pathologies.name: Plan sin fricción / Frictionless plan
pathologies.definition: Success requires perfect coordination, data and timing.
pathologies.mechanism: The schedule assumes perfect data, means and decisions.
pathologies.correction: Test coordination failures and preserve margins.

pathologies.name: Velocidad desorientada / Disoriented speed
pathologies.definition: Faster action on a false or unrevised model.
pathologies.mechanism: The organisation rewards immediate response and penalises revising assumptions.
pathologies.correction: Separate detection, interpretation, authorisation and effect times.

pathologies.name: Culminación negada / Denied culmination
pathologies.definition: Early success justifies continuing after the marginal sign has changed.
pathologies.mechanism: Past success is used to justify the next commitment.
pathologies.correction: Compare the marginal benefit of continuing with consolidating.

pathologies.name: Simetría refleja / Reflex symmetry
pathologies.definition: Competing where the adversary converts better.
pathologies.mechanism: Each move of the adversary fixes our own response (the way the pathology reproduces itself).
pathologies.correction: Recover the purpose and compare domains of action.

pathologies.name: Victoria ilegítima / Illegitimate victory
pathologies.definition: The method destroys the authority or cooperation needed to consolidate the result.
pathologies.mechanism: The immediate effect hides damage to later cooperation.
pathologies.correction: Examine procedure, distribution and capacity for repair.

pathologies.name: Atribución de intención / Intent attribution
pathologies.definition: A psychological inference is treated as fact.
pathologies.mechanism: Every ambiguity confirms a hostile explanation.

pathologies.name: Sustitución métrica / Metric substitution
pathologies.definition: The indicator is optimised at the expense of the end.
pathologies.mechanism: Incentives change the record or the conduct to improve the number.
pathologies.correction: Review the relation between measure, mechanism and result.

pathologies.name: Escalada de compromiso / Escalation of commitment
pathologies.definition: Past cost becomes an argument for more future cost.
pathologies.mechanism: Withdrawing threatens the identity of whoever decided before.
pathologies.correction: Compare options from the present, excluding unrecoverable costs.

pathologies.name: Personalización crónica / Chronic personalization
pathologies.definition: Recurrent conflicts are renegotiated from zero because no institution absorbs them.
pathologies.mechanism: Gaps in procedure are resolved through relationships and selective precedent.
pathologies.correction: Define rule, authority, exception and appeal.
